examples.japanese: {三年|さんねん}{前|まえ}に{来|き}た。
{駅|えき}の{前|まえ}で{待|ま}っています。
examples.english: I'm waiting in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {前|まえ}に{進|すす}んでください。
{彼|かれ}は{前|まえ}の{席|せき}に{座|すわ}っている。
examples.english: He's sitting in the front seat.

examples.japanese: {一週間|いっしゅうかん}{前|まえ}に{届|とど}きました。
{食事|しょくじ}の{前|まえ}に{手|て}を{洗|あら}ってください。
examples.english: Please wash your hands before the meal.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{本|ほん}を{読|よ}みます。
examples.english: I read a book before going to bed.

examples.japanese: {前|まえ}に{会|あ}ったことがありますか。
{車|くるま}の{前|まえ}に{立|た}たないでください。
examples.english: Please don't stand in front of the car.

notes:
{前|まえ} means front (spatial) and before (temporal). A fundamental word with many uses.

CONTRAST:
- {前|まえ}: front, before
- {後|うしろ}: behind (spatial)
- {後|あと}: after (temporal)

TIME PATTERNS:
- ～{前|まえ}に: before ~
- {時間|じかん}＋{前|まえ}: ~ ago (e.g., {三年|さんねん}{前|まえ})

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {前|まえ}に{進|すす}む: to move forward
- {前|まえ}を{向|む}く: to face forward, look ahead
- {駅前|えきまえ}: in front of the station

COMPOUNDS:
- {以前|いぜん}: before, previously (formal)
- {名前|なまえ}: name
- {前売|まえう}り: advance sale
- {午前|ごぜん}: morning, AM
- {事前|じぜん}: beforehand, in advance
